finalText:
Common cause: parent pass new object/array/function literal each render — new reference, child see "different" prop even if content same.

Fixes:
- Wrap child in `React.memo()` — shallow-compare props.
- Memoize object/array props with `useMemo`.
- Memoize function props with `useCallback`.
- Check context — if child consume Context, any provider value change re-render all consumers regardless of props.

No `React.memo` on child = default re-render every parent render, prop content irrelevant.
